name: Timothy K. Mule
bio: I'm usually the one listening more than talking but always friendly. I value good conversations with good people and appreciate the little moments that made school memorable.
kindWord:
To my classmates,
What a journey it has been. We walked into campus as strangers and somehow leave as stories in each other's lives. Along the way we found friends, a few rivals, unexpected business partners, teammates and people who became family. We celebrated victories, survived deadlines, showed up for parties, missed a few classes and somehow still made it to the end.
Some sacrificed their time, energy and peace of mind to keep the class moving forward. Others made us laugh when the pressure was too much. Every person added something to this chapter, whether big or small. Personally, I cherished every moment.
Here's to chasing our dreams, meeting again with bigger stories to tell and never forgetting where it all began. Cheers to us🥂.
